title: Rất vui được gặp bạn
pronunciation: zuht voo ee duhk gap ban
summary: A warm first-meeting line after names or introductions.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Rất vui được gặp bạn is the friendly line for meeting someone for the first time. It works after names, introductions, a guide handoff, a class, a homestay welcome, or a helpful local exchange that becomes personal enough for warmth.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say Rất vui được gặp bạn after the greeting and introduction, not as the first word at a counter.

phrases.pronunciation: zuht voo ee duhk gap ban

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The sentence says you are very happy to get to meet the person.

sections.title: Natural introduction chain
sections.body: This line usually comes after a hello and before a thank-you or goodbye.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it after someone introduces themselves, after meeting a guide or host, at a language exchange, in a class, or when a helpful local interaction turns into a friendly introduction.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Bạn makes the phrase peer-friendly. With a clearly older person, the same idea can become more local when the relationship word changes, but this version is a safe first page for travelers.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: These help you start and close the same friendly exchange.
